notes.method: Edge 0 bay positions from a 1-D homography on 144 (2019, near-frontal) and 041 (2025, oblique from the NW), scaled to the 12.2 m OSM edge; the two photos agree within 0.2 m. Heights from 144 at ~64 px/m mid-facade: terrace +0.7, canopy/springing 3.5 m above the terrace, upper sills ~5.4, window heads ~7.3, parapet top ~9.1 above the terrace.
notes.terrace: The raised terrace (+0.7 m, curved steps, grey tube railing) is not in the model, so all heights are absolute above the square; the shop openings therefore run 0.7 m lower than in reality.
notes.compromises: Springing set to 4.0 instead of 4.2 and the upper sills ~0.27 m high, so the generated string course (always 0.9+0.12 m below the sill) clears the arch heads. Floodlights between the upper windows are wall_lantern stand-ins. The orange box awning over bay 1 (2025) is an extra awning in the generic awning material. Edge 1: the SCSC entrance (door with a small gabled hood, two arched windows above, 145) at the west end facing the forecourt of the CIC gate; positions low confidence; the rest is the 3-4 m passage to the CIC (notes B4).
notes.edges: Edge keys follow the scene_spec ring as of 2026-10-19 evening (ring start rotated by the city-wide make_spec changes): 7 = west facade on the square (u from the north end), 0 = south face towards the CIC (u from the west end). Before the rotation these were 0 and 1.
